security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost https://asset.localhost data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first file, image, video, and PDF utilities for developers
bundle.longDescription: Convert and compress images, prepare website icons, extract PDFs to Markdown, optimize PDFs locally with a bundled qpdf engine, and compress and convert videos locally with a bundled FFmpeg. Nothing is ever uploaded.
